packageRules.description: The floor of kotlinx-coroutines and kotlinx-serialization that libraries compile against (ADR 0024); raised by hand when the oldest supported Spring Boot line moves. The *-latest entries in the catalog stay under Renovate.
The oldest Kotlin a supported framework line ships (ADR 0024); raised by hand.
The Spring line pendenz-spring compiles against (ADR 0023): the last of Spring 6. The spring7 entry, which the second test run uses, stays under Renovate.
The oldest Spring Boot line the starter compiles against (ADR 0023, ADR 0024); raised by hand when it leaves support.
The oldest Micrometer line in open-source support (ADR 0022); raised by hand when its support ends.
Hibernate 6, the line Spring 6.2 runs JPA with in the transaction tests. The hibernate7 entry stays under Renovate.
The Servlet API pendenz-mcp compiles against, the oldest a supported container provides (ADR 0021).
